def check_sasrec_relative_attention():
    # Tiny CPU fixtures isolate RNG and leave both experts' training streams,
    # objectives, sampling, fusion grid and runtime allocations unchanged.
    with torch.random.fork_rng(devices=[]):
        torch.random.default_generator.manual_seed(123)
        config = dict(maxlen=4, hidden_units=8, num_blocks=2,
                      num_heads=2, dropout_rate=0.0)
        model = SASRec(7, **config).eval()
        legacy = SASRec(7, **config, architecture_version=1).eval()
        legacy.load_state_dict({
            key: value for key, value in model.state_dict().items()
            if not key.endswith("relative_attention_bias")
        }, strict=True)
        seq = torch.tensor([[0, 1, 2, 3], [1, 2, 3, 4], [0, 0, 0, 0]])
        candidates = torch.tensor([[7, 2, 5, 1]]).expand(3, -1)
        for attention in model.attention_layers:
            assert attention.relative_attention_bias.shape == (2, 4)
            assert torch.count_nonzero(attention.relative_attention_bias) == 0
        with torch.no_grad():
            torch.testing.assert_close(model(seq), legacy(seq))
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                model.predict(seq, candidates), legacy.predict(seq, candidates)
            )
        loss = model.predict(seq, candidates).square().sum()
        gradients = torch.autograd.grad(
            loss, [attention.relative_attention_bias
                   for attention in model.attention_layers]
        )
        for gradient in gradients:
            assert torch.isfinite(gradient).all()
            assert gradient.abs().sum().item() > 0.0
        with torch.no_grad():
            for attention in model.attention_layers:
                attention.relative_attention_bias.copy_(
                    torch.linspace(-0.4, 0.6, 8).reshape(2, 4)
                )
            features = model(seq)
            assert torch.isfinite(features).all()
            assert torch.count_nonzero(features[seq == 0]) == 0
            changed_future = seq.clone()
            changed_future[:, -1] = 6
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                features[:, :-1], model(changed_future)[:, :-1],
                rtol=0, atol=0,
            )
            permutation = torch.tensor([2, 0, 3, 1])
            scores = model.predict(seq, candidates)
            torch.testing.assert_close(
                model.predict(seq, candidates[:, permutation]),
                scores[:, permutation], rtol=0, atol=0,
            )
    print("SASRec relative-attention fixtures passed", flush=True)
